text: また　クチバに　くる　ときまで　ごきげんよう！

structure.jp: また　クチバに　くる　ときまで
structure.en: until the time we come to Vermilion again

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき right after a verb means 'the time when that happens'. くる　とき = 'the time when we come'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで says how far something goes on, here in time. くる　ときまで = 'until the time we come'.
